page.overview:
Who is Con Wizard?

Con Wizard is a minor character appearing in "Wizard City", though he initially introduces himself as Song Wizard. Played by Anthony Stewart Head.

In the episode, he tricked Pep by singing him a song about Wizard City, stealing his books shortly after. The two then chased each other throughout the city until Con Wizard was finally tackled. He eventually freed himself, but the dark force of Peppermint Butler took over Pep and allowed him to use a spell to remove the wizards head from his body. The Wizard Police were then called, but his body was able to find his head, and so he ran away with it while the police pursued.

Con Wizard appears to be a blue humanoid that wears blue fancy renaissance clothing. His shirt and cone-like cap also appear to be covered in yellow stars. He also wears a pair of dark-blue shoes.
